units.source_text: 从战败的翌日起，寺庙每日的功课又依然如故。

en.t: From the day after the defeat, the temple's daily routine went back to exactly as it had been.

units.source_text: 杂务、斋座、晚餐、入浴、就寝……

en.t: Chores, the midday meal, supper, bathing, bedtime...

units.source_text: 再加上老师严禁买黑市米，只得靠施主的捐赠，也许副司照顾到我们正处在发育身体的年龄，有时谎称是施主的捐献，买回来少量的黑市米。

en.t: On top of that, our teacher strictly forbade buying black-market rice, so we had to rely on donations from patrons; perhaps because the deputy prior took pity on us, still being at an age when our bodies were growing, he would sometimes pretend it was a patron's offering and buy back a small amount of black-market rice.

units.source_text: 我们的粥碗沉底的只有少得可怜的几粒米饭。

en.t: At the bottom of our bowls of gruel there were only a pitiably few grains of rice.
We also often went out to buy sweet potatoes.

units.source_text: 一日三餐，不仅早餐，连午餐。

en.t: For all three meals a day, not only breakfast but even lunch,

units.source_text: 晚餐也都吃稀粥和白薯。

en.t: and supper too, we ate thin gruel and sweet potatoes.

units.source_text: 我们总是处在饥饿的状态。

en.t: We were always in a state of hunger.
